status: Written BEFORE public validation was opened. Validation has never been loaded by any research code.
procedure: Run starter/backtester.py --split validation once at cost multipliers 1.0, 1.5 and 2.0. No change to code or config afterwards, whatever the result.

expectations_stated_in_advance.sampling_noise: 132 sessions gives an annualised Sharpe standard error of about sqrt(252/132) = 1.4. Any validation Sharpe between roughly -1.5 and +4 is consistent with the development estimate (full-dev Sharpe 1.22, 2023-24 out-of-sample 1.79).
expectations_stated_in_advance.what_would_worry_us: A validation Sharpe below about -1.5, a drawdown much beyond the development maximum of -5.9%, any constraint adjustment day, or turnover far from ~31 per year (which would suggest a behaviour change rather than noise).
expectations_stated_in_advance.prior_on_2021_like_regime: Both signals were weak in 2021; a similar regime would show up as a small negative return, not a failure of the method.
